cards.ex: Before you leave, can I have a quick word about the Henderson account?
cards.exUz: Ketishingizdan oldin, Henderson hisobi haqida qisqacha gaplashsak bo'ladimi?
cards.uzDef: Tez va muhim bir narsa haqida gaplashish.

cards.ex: I think we need to clear the air after that argument.
cards.exUz: O'sha janjaldan keyin muammoni hal qilishimiz kerak deb o'ylayman.

cards.ex: She's at the forefront of research into renewable energy.
cards.exUz: U qayta tiklanadigan energiya bo'yicha tadqiqotlarning oldingi safida.
cards.uzDef: Eng muhim yoki faol pozitsiyada bo'lish.

cards.ex: Can you give me a ballpark figure for the cost of the project?
cards.exUz: Loyiha narxi uchun taxminiy raqamni ayta olasizmi?

cards.ex: It's important to keep abreast of developments in the industry.
cards.exUz: Sanoatdagi o'zgarishlardan xabardor bo'lish muhim.
cards.uzDef: So'nggi ma'lumotlardan doimo xabardor bo'lib turish.

cards.ex: We have several new projects in the pipeline for next year.
cards.exUz: Keyingi yil uchun bir nechta yangi loyihalar rejalashtirilgan.
cards.uzDef: Hali amalga oshirilmagan, lekin rejalashtirilgan narsalar.

cards.ex: I'll touch upon the key issues in my presentation.
cards.exUz: Taqdimotimda asosiy masalalarga qisqacha to'xtalib o'taman.

cards.ex: Let's get the ball rolling on this project as soon as possible.
cards.exUz: Keling, ushbu loyihani imkon qadar tezroq boshlaylik.

cards.ex: We've had to put that project on the back burner for now.
cards.exUz: Biz hozircha ushbu loyihani vaqtincha chetga surishga majbur bo'ldik.
cards.uzDef: Hozircha muhim bo'lmagan vaqtincha to'xtatilgan loyiha.

cards.ex: This investment will be beneficial in the long run.
cards.exUz: Ushbu sarmoya uzoq muddatda foydali bo'ladi.

cards.ex: To be frank, I'm not sure about this plan.
cards.exUz: Ochig'ini aytsam, bu reja haqida ishonchim yo'q.

cards.ex: We will take your suggestions on board and review them.
cards.exUz: Biz sizning takliflaringizni hisobga olamiz va ularni ko'rib chiqamiz.
cards.uzDef: Biror fikrni qabul qilish, hisobga olish.

cards.ex: Let's draw up a plan of action before we start.
cards.exUz: Boshlashdan oldin harakatlar rejasini tuzaylik.

cards.ex: Can you bring me up to speed on the latest developments?
cards.exUz: Meni so'nggi o'zgarishlar haqida xabardor qila olasizmi?

cards.ex: I respect your point of view, even if I don't agree with it.
cards.exUz: Sizning nuqtai nazaringizni hurmat qilaman, hatto unga qo'shilmasam ham.

cards.ex: We need to get back to basics and focus on our core business.
cards.exUz: Biz asosga qaytishimiz va asosiy biznesimizga e'tibor qaratishimiz kerak.

cards.ex: On second thought, maybe we should postpone the meeting.
cards.exUz: O'ylab ko'rib, ehtimol, uchrashuvni keyinga qoldirishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Yangi fikrga kelgan payt, boshqacha qarash.

cards.ex: Can you fill me in on what happened at the meeting?
cards.exUz: Uchrashuvda nima bo'lgani haqida menga ma'lumot bera olasizmi?

cards.ex: I feel like I'm out of the loop on this project.
cards.exUz: Men ushbu loyiha haqida xabarsiz qolganga o'xshayman.

cards.ex: I can give you a rough estimate, but it might change.
cards.exUz: Men sizga taxminiy baho bera olaman, lekin u o'zgarishi mumkin.

cards.ex: You will receive a response in due course.
cards.exUz: Siz vaqti kelganda javob olasiz.

cards.ex: To err on the side of caution, we should double-check everything.
cards.exUz: Ehtiyotkorlik yuzasidan, biz hamma narsani qayta tekshirishimiz kerak.

cards.ex: At this juncture, we need to make a decision.
cards.exUz: Shu paytda biz qaror qabul qilishimiz kerak.

cards.ex: With respect to your question, I need more information.
cards.exUz: Savolingizga nisbatan, menga ko'proq ma'lumot kerak.

cards.ex: In a nutshell, the project was a success.
cards.exUz: Qisqasi, loyiha muvaffaqiyatli bo'ldi.

cards.ex: There's a steep learning curve when you start this job.
cards.exUz: Ushbu ishni boshlaganingizda tez o'rganishingiz kerak bo'ladi.

cards.ex: We need to weigh up the pros and cons before making a decision.
cards.exUz: Qaror qabul qilishdan oldin foyda va zararni baholashimiz kerak.

cards.ex: We need to deal with the issue at hand immediately.
cards.exUz: Biz hozir qo'l ostida bo'lgan muammoni zudlik bilan hal qilishimiz kerak.

cards.ex: Your application is currently under consideration.
cards.exUz: Sizning arizangiz hozirda ko'rib chiqilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Hozirda baholanayotgan yoki muhokama qilinayotgan narsa.

cards.ex: Finally, after years of hard work, our plans have come to fruition.
cards.exUz: Nihoyat, yillar davomidagi mashaqqatli mehnatdan so'ng rejalarimiz amalga oshdi.
